example_prompt: Handle the Cartflox transfer.failed webhook and log why a payout was rejected.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

reference.description: Cartflox reference, sent to the provider. Also accepted by `GET /v1/transfers/{id}`.

status.description:
`pending`: created, not handed to the provider yet. `processing`: handed to the provider, the operator is processing it (the most frequent state right after the call).
`succeeded`: the money reached the recipient, `completed` carries the date. `failed`: refused by the operator or the provider, `failure` says why, nothing was debited.

fee.description: Cartflox fee. `0` with your own gateway keys.

provider_operator.description: Operator code as the provider names it (`ORANGE_CIV`).

provider_reference.description: Reference at the provider, when it differs from `reference`.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

gotchas: data.failure carries the code and the message, and nothing was debited.
Transfers are refused with a test key, so transfer events cannot be produced in test mode.

Verify every delivery before acting on it, choosing the secret key of the event's mode (livemode: false is signed with the test secret key): X-Afriflow-Signature is t=<ts>,v1=<hex>, where v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 hex, keyed with your secret key (the production key, or the test key for a test event), of the string <ts>.<raw body> with X-Afriflow-Timestamp as <ts>. Compute it over the raw body bytes as received, compare in constant time, and reject the request when |now - ts| exceeds 5 minutes.

The webhook headers use the X-Afriflow- prefix, not X-Cartflox-: X-Afriflow-Timestamp, X-Afriflow-Signature, X-Afriflow-Event (the event name) and X-Afriflow-Delivery (the delivery id, identical on every retry: deduplicate on it), with User-Agent: Cartflox-Webhooks/2.

Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds and process afterwards. Without a 2xx, Cartflox makes up to 10 attempts in total over about 72 hours (the first immediate, then +1 min, +5 min, +15 min, +1 h, +3 h, +6 h, +12 h, +24 h, +24 h), so the same event can arrive more than once. The address and the signing key are read again at every attempt.

Test events go to the production webhook URL with livemode: false unless a test URL is set with PATCH /v1/config/webhook and {"mode": "test"}; branch on livemode, and verify with the secret key of the same mode.
Only the events selected with PATCH /v1/config/webhook are sent; by default all of them are.
